basis_note: COPPA paraphrase: verifiable parental consent before collecting a child's data; a separate parental consent before disclosing it to third parties unless integral to the service; no indefinite retention. Project: guardian consents; the child is never a marketing or advertising target; no child contact details in any share. Whether a club is a third party is NOT decided here.
